name: Wild Growth Hair Oil
notes: DENSITY CORRECTED: added Fine. Pure oil — oils are dosage-adjustable regardless of hair density (fine hair users just apply fewer drops), no basis to exclude Fine from an oil product. MINERAL OIL VERIFIED: manufacturer's official ingredient notice lists only plant oils (coconut, olive, jojoba, rice bran, cocoa butter, acerola, pomegranate, rosehip, pumpkin seed) plus extracts and essential oils — no mineral oil. Note the brand does not publish a true INCI list, so this rests on manufacturer statement, not a regulated label.
keyIngredients: Proprietary oil blend (full INCI not published by brand)

name: Pomegranate & Honey Curl Defining Mousse
notes: CORRECTED: added Low. Mousse/foam format distributes thin with low buildup risk — pomegranate/honey (humectant-forward) formula, no basis to exclude Low. P&G acquired majority ownership in 2023, no longer Black-owned though still Black-led.
keyIngredients: Pomegranate Extract, Honey (full detailed INCI not independently confirmed)

name: Almond Avocado Curl Enhancing Mousse
notes: CORRECTED: added Low. Mousse/foam format whips oils into a thin, low-buildup-risk foam — no strong evidence to exclude Low even with almond/avocado oil present. Full INCI not independently confirmed — needs follow-up.
keyIngredients: Almond Oil, Avocado Oil (full INCI not independently confirmed — needs follow-up)

name: I Create Hold
notes: Clean/organic aloe + honey gel, firm hold with shine; brand pairs with Sweet Spirit and Pure Inspiration already in the base. Concentrated — 1–2 pumps is usually enough, so the 10 oz lasts. No synthetic fragrance, but scented with organic orange peel oil (limonene), so not fragrance-free. Note: recently reformulated and some long-time users report the new version performs worse — worth watching sentiment. Also sold in 32 oz refill. EWG score not published.

name: Amla Hair Oil
notes: DENSITY CORRECTED: added Fine. Pure oil, traditionally used as a light daily Ayurvedic oil — dosage-adjustable, no basis to exclude Fine. ⚠️ NOT MINERAL OIL FREE — verified: Paraffinum Liquidum (mineral oil) is the FIRST ingredient, ahead of canola and palm oil; amla is present as an extract. Despite the name, this is a mineral-oil-based product, not a botanical oil. Exclude from any mineral-oil-free or 'clean' recommendation path, and don't group it with the plant-oil sealants.
keyIngredients: Amla (Indian Gooseberry) Oil (full INCI not independently confirmed)

name: No. 5 Bond Maintenance Strengthening Hair Repair Conditioner
notes: DENSITY CORRECTED: added Fine. Bond-building conditioner, brand markets as suitable for all hair types — bond-builders are often specifically good for fine, damage-prone hair, not a reason to exclude it.
keyIngredients: Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate (bond-building complex), conditioning agents (full INCI not independently verified)

name: Moisture Recovery
notes: CORRECTED: sulfate-containing shampoo (Sodium Laureth Sulfate) — tagged Normal porosity only, not High. Professional/salon brand (owned by Henkel, not Black-owned). Also contains Silicone Quaternium-16 and multiple peptides/Hydrolyzed Keratin — flag for silicone AND protein-sensitive users too. Formulated for thick/coarse/very dry hair, but sulfate content means porosity tag stays Normal regardless of density marketing.
